card.name: Words leading into caution or risk phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, in, only, without, of that come just before a caution or risk statement in warnings. Also fires inside product names in warning sentences, such as injection names and G6PD.

modes.label: Linking word before caution
modes.description: A preposition or adverb right before a word about caution, risk or harm.
modes.example: Thiazides should be used<< with>> caution in severe renal disease.

modes.label: Inside product or test names in warnings
modes.description: Partway through a drug or test name within a warning sentence.
